title: Design a URL Shortener
description: Design a service like bit.ly that takes a long URL and returns a short alias. The system should redirect users to the original URL when the alias is accessed. Consider read-heavy traffic, collision handling, and analytics.

componentRoles.CLIENT: The user or browser making requests to shorten a URL or follow a short link.
componentRoles.LOAD_BALANCER: Distributes redirect and write traffic across multiple gateway instances to prevent bottlenecks.
componentRoles.API_GATEWAY: Single entry point — routes POST /shorten to the Write Service and GET /{code} to the Read Service.
componentRoles.URL_WRITE_SERVICE: Generates the short code via the ID Generator, stores the long-URL mapping in the database.
componentRoles.URL_READ_SERVICE: Resolves the short code — checks Redis first (cache hit), falls back to DB (cache miss), then publishes a click event to the queue.
componentRoles.ID_GENERATOR: Produces collision-resistant unique IDs using Base62 encoding or a distributed counter.
componentRoles.REDIS_CACHE: Stores frequently accessed short-code → long-URL mappings so redirects are served without hitting the DB on every request.
componentRoles.RELATIONAL_DB: Persistent store for all short-code → long-URL mappings, user data, and metadata.
componentRoles.QUEUE: Receives click events from the Read Service and decouples analytics processing from the redirect hot path.
componentRoles.ANALYTICS_SERVICE: Consumes click events from the queue and writes aggregated analytics to a separate store.

title: Design a Rate Limiter
description: Design a rate limiter that restricts the number of requests a client can make to an API within a time window. It should work in a distributed environment where multiple API servers are running.

componentRoles.CLIENT: The caller making API requests that need to be rate-limited.
componentRoles.LOAD_BALANCER: Distributes incoming traffic across multiple API Gateway instances in the distributed setup.
componentRoles.API_GATEWAY: Entry point — forwards each request to the Rate Limiter Service before allowing it to proceed to the application.
componentRoles.RATE_LIMITER_SERVICE: Implements the rate limiting algorithm (token bucket, sliding window). Reads and increments counters in Redis for each request.
componentRoles.REDIS_CACHE: Stores per-client request counters. Shared across all gateway instances so rate limiting is consistent in a distributed setup.
componentRoles.APP_SERVICE: Handles the actual business logic for allowed requests. Receives traffic only after the rate limiter approves.
componentRoles.QUEUE: Receives metrics events from the Rate Limiter for async processing — decouples analytics from the hot path.
componentRoles.ANALYTICS_SERVICE: Consumes rate-limit metrics from the queue and stores them for monitoring and alerting.

title: Design Twitter's News Feed
description: Design the home timeline feature of Twitter where users see a feed of tweets from people they follow. Consider fan-out on write, caching strategies, and the difference between celebrities and normal users.

componentRoles.CLIENT: The web or mobile app user composing tweets or loading their home timeline.
componentRoles.LOAD_BALANCER: Spreads read (timeline) and write (tweet) traffic across multiple gateway instances.
componentRoles.API_GATEWAY: Routes POST /tweet to the Post Service and GET /feed to the Feed Service.
componentRoles.POST_SERVICE: Handles tweet creation — stores the tweet in the Tweet DB, uploads media via Media Service, and publishes a tweet event to the queue.
componentRoles.FEED_SERVICE: Serves the home timeline — reads pre-computed timelines from Redis cache; falls back to the Tweet DB on a cache miss.
componentRoles.USER_SERVICE: Manages follow-graph data. The Timeline Worker queries it to get the list of followers when fanning out a new tweet.
componentRoles.MEDIA_SERVICE: Handles media uploads (images, videos) triggered by the Post Service.
componentRoles.REDIS_CACHE: Stores pre-computed per-user timelines so Feed Service reads are fast without hitting the database.
componentRoles.NON_RELATIONAL_DB: Stores tweet content — chosen for write throughput and horizontal scalability (e.g. Cassandra).
componentRoles.RELATIONAL_DB: Stores user profiles, follow-graph relationships — structured data that benefits from relational queries.
componentRoles.QUEUE: Receives tweet events from Post Service and decouples the fan-out process from the write path.
componentRoles.TIMELINE_WORKER: Consumes tweet events, fetches the author's follower list from User Service, and writes the tweet ID into each follower's Redis timeline cache.

title: Design YouTube
description: Design a video hosting and streaming platform. Users should be able to upload videos, which are transcoded into multiple resolutions, and stream them on demand. Include search, recommendations, and CDN-based delivery.

componentRoles.CLIENT: Web or mobile app — initiates uploads, requests video streams, searches, and recommendations.
componentRoles.LOAD_BALANCER: Distributes all inbound traffic across multiple gateway instances.
componentRoles.API_GATEWAY: Routes requests to the correct service: uploads, streaming, search, or recommendations.
componentRoles.UPLOAD_SERVICE: Accepts raw video, stores it in Object Storage, triggers transcoding/thumbnailing via the queue, and saves metadata.
componentRoles.STREAMING_SERVICE: Handles video watch requests — fetches metadata from cache (or DB on miss), then streams video via CDN.
componentRoles.METADATA_SERVICE: Persists video metadata (title, description, tags, resolution info) to the database.
componentRoles.RECOMMENDATION_SERVICE: Queries the metadata DB to generate personalised video recommendations.
componentRoles.SEARCH_SERVICE: Full-text search over video metadata stored in the database.
componentRoles.OBJECT_STORAGE: Blob store (e.g. S3) for raw uploads, all transcoded resolution variants, and thumbnail images.
componentRoles.NON_RELATIONAL_DB: Stores video metadata at scale — chosen for write throughput and horizontal scalability.
componentRoles.REDIS_CACHE: Caches frequently accessed video metadata so Streaming Service reads are fast.
componentRoles.CDN: Edge-caches video chunks close to users. Fetches from Object Storage on a cache miss.
componentRoles.QUEUE: Decouples the upload hot path from transcoding and thumbnail generation — both workers consume from this queue.
componentRoles.TRANSCODING_SERVICE: Converts the original upload into multiple resolutions (360p, 720p, 1080p) and writes each variant back to Object Storage.
componentRoles.THUMBNAIL_SERVICE: Generates preview thumbnails from the video and stores them in Object Storage.

title: Design Uber
description: Design a ride-hailing platform where riders can request rides and drivers can accept them. Consider real-time driver location tracking, ride matching, trip management, and payment processing.

componentRoles.CLIENT: Rider app and Driver app — both route through the same Load Balancer and Gateway.
componentRoles.LOAD_BALANCER: Balances high-frequency driver location pings and rider ride requests across gateway instances.
componentRoles.API_GATEWAY: Routes requests to the appropriate service based on the operation type.
componentRoles.USER_SERVICE: Manages rider and driver profiles, authentication, and account data stored in a relational DB.
componentRoles.LOCATION_SERVICE: Receives continuous GPS updates from driver apps and writes current driver positions to Redis.
componentRoles.MATCHING_SERVICE: Queries Redis for nearby drivers, finds the best match for a ride request, and publishes a ride event to the queue.
componentRoles.TRIP_SERVICE: Creates and updates trip records as the ride progresses. Triggers payment on completion.
componentRoles.PAYMENT_SERVICE: Processes payments on trip completion and records payment status in the database.
componentRoles.NOTIFICATION_SERVICE: Consumes ride request events from the queue and pushes notifications to the matched driver app.
componentRoles.REDIS_CACHE: Stores real-time driver location data — enables fast geospatial queries for the Matching Service.
componentRoles.RELATIONAL_DB: Stores structured user and driver profile data where relationships and consistency matter.
componentRoles.NON_RELATIONAL_DB: Stores trip records and payment records — chosen for write throughput during high-demand periods.
componentRoles.QUEUE: Decouples ride matching from notification delivery — the Matching Service publishes, Notification Service consumes.

title: Design WhatsApp
description: Design a real-time messaging application. Users should be able to send messages that are delivered instantly if the recipient is online, or stored for later delivery if offline. Consider presence tracking, WebSocket connections, and message persistence.

componentRoles.CLIENT: WhatsApp client for the sender and recipient — connects via WebSocket to the Chat Service for real-time messaging.
componentRoles.LOAD_BALANCER: Distributes persistent WebSocket connections across multiple Chat Service instances.
componentRoles.API_GATEWAY: Entry point for all connections — routes to Auth, Chat, or Presence Service based on the operation.
componentRoles.AUTH_SERVICE: Authenticates users on connection and validates tokens. Reads user records from the relational DB.
componentRoles.CHAT_SERVICE: The WebSocket server — receives messages, persists them to the Message DB, checks recipient presence via Redis, delivers directly if online, or queues for push notification if offline.
componentRoles.PRESENCE_SERVICE: Tracks which users are currently online by writing session state to Redis.
componentRoles.NOTIFICATION_SERVICE: Consumes offline message events from the queue and sends push notifications to the recipient's device.
componentRoles.REDIS_CACHE: Stores online user sessions (Presence Service) and active WebSocket connection metadata (Chat Service).
componentRoles.RELATIONAL_DB: Stores user accounts, contact lists, and profile data — structured data suited for relational queries.
componentRoles.NON_RELATIONAL_DB: Stores message history — chosen for high write throughput and append-only access patterns (e.g. Cassandra).
componentRoles.QUEUE: Receives offline delivery events from Chat Service and decouples push notification delivery.
